executive_summary.conclusion: The English landing page exposes strong first-party institutional and current-news facts, and the sampled contact and student-support pages are readable to a static collector. Important visitor tasks remain difficult to resolve because the homepage/title provides weak orientation and the linked Academic Fee destination contains no fee information in the inspected text; rendered behavior and actual assistant visibility were not measured.

not_checked: Rendered browser journeys, responsive/accessibility behavior, headers and rendered DOM were unavailable by restriction.
Actual assistant answers/citations were not measured.
robots.txt returned 404 (unavailable 4xx); no provider-specific crawler access was established.
PDF contents and external payment/application handoffs were not opened.

findings.title: Landing-page title and opening orientation are generic

evidence.observation: The supplied English landing page title is '~: Tamil University :~'; its opening text begins with a long undifferentiated news list before 'Welcome to Tamil University, Thanjavur'. The page does not state the primary visitor audiences or a concise route to admissions, programmes, research, or contact in the opening copy.

suggested_action.summary: Set a descriptive English title and add a concise above-the-fold orientation block with audience-specific links.
suggested_action.mechanism: A clear entity-purpose-audience statement and explicit Admissions, Academic Programmes, Research, Student Support, and Contact links improve extraction and information scent.
suggested_action.verification: Static fetch shows a descriptive title and opening summary, with named links to each primary visitor task before the news feed.

findings.title: Academic Fee route does not answer the fee question in sampled text

evidence.observation: The homepage exposes an 'Academic Fee' destination, but the inspected page contains only the heading 'Academic Fee' plus shared navigation/news text; no amount, programme scope, currency, effective period, or instructions are present in the extracted page text.

suggested_action.summary: Publish current fee tables or a clearly labeled fee document on the Academic Fee page, with programme, student category, currency, effective session, and contact/next-step qualifiers.
suggested_action.mechanism: Decision-critical fee facts in readable page text (and linked accessible documents where needed) let prospective students and retrieval systems answer cost questions without relying on an empty route.
suggested_action.verification: For each listed programme/category, the page exposes amount, unit/currency, session/effective date, and a working next-step/contact route in static text.

readiness.detail: Five same-authority HTML pages returned HTTP 200. robots.txt returned 404, so no explicit restrictions were observed; this does not prove provider access.
Static text exposed institutional history, contact details, student-support programmes, news and navigation links. Rendered equivalence, media alternatives and headers were not checked.
Institutional-purpose, contact and student-support questions are supported in sample; the Academic Fee route remains unresolved because no fee elements were found in its inspected text.
Exact-entity search returned the audited official site and Tamil Nadu Raj Bhavan's state-university listing naming Tamil University, Thanjavur. No contradiction was observed in the bounded sample.
Static links expose contact, Academic Fee, student support and admissions/news routes, but browser interaction, responsive layout and destination handoffs were not available in this restricted run.

intent_tests.question: What is Tamil University and what does it focus on?

evidence.quote: Welcome to Tamil University, Thanjavur ... established ... for furthering the advancement of learning and research in Tamil language, literature and culture ... UGC ... recognized the University

intent_tests.reason: All required elements are stated in readable landing-page text.

intent_tests.question: How can a visitor contact the university about courses, research or support?

evidence.quote: For any query and support for Tamil Language and culture, academic courses, research activities ... Our contact details are ... Admission Section Phone:04362 227089

intent_tests.reason: The page provides purpose-specific offices, phone numbers and email addresses.

intent_tests.question: What academic fee should a prospective student expect?
intent_tests.reason: The relevant page is reachable and named, but the inspected text contains none of the required fee elements.

intent_tests.question: What student support is available after enrolment?

evidence.quote: Capability Enhancement and Development Schemes for Students ... Guidance Cell for Competitive Exams and Career Counselling ... Soft skill development ... Yoga and Meditation ... Personal Counselling

intent_tests.reason: The page names the student audience and multiple concrete support services with examples.

steps.action: Inspect homepage links and select the Academic Fee destination
steps.observation: A same-authority Academic Fee link is exposed in the navigation/news area.
The static page heading is present, but no fee values or qualifiers appear in extracted text.

journeys.reason: The route reaches a public page but does not resolve the decision-critical fee task in inspected text; interactive/rendered behavior was not checked.

journeys.task: Visitor verifies support options and reaches a contact route

steps.observation: The page lists competitive-exam guidance, career counselling, soft skills, yoga and personal counselling.

steps.observation: The page provides admission, registrar, vice-chancellor and other office phone/email routes.

journeys.reason: Static destinations and content were inspected, but browser navigation, link activation and continuity could not be observed under the no-browser restriction.

visibility.detail: No actual assistant answer runs or citation observations were recorded; bounded web retrieval is not an assistant-visibility measurement.
